== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Commander is a specialized role within the fleet that serves as a central hub for tactical operations. Rather than outranking a Captain, this position focuses on enhancing the performance of various systems, including sensors, fighters, shuttles, and specific tactical components. A Commander's unique abilities can improve the overall effectiveness of their targets, with some individuals providing broad enhancements to all [[aspects]] of a ship's operation. In certain fleet structures, the Commander is tasked with leading entire fleets to new levels of success and may be granted access to specific fleet-command systems upon their arrival. While the role is distinct from strategic command or direct combat, Commanders are vital to fleet coordination and can be assigned to specific vessels, such as the [[Shadow Ark]], to serve as guardians.}}

== Notable quotes ==
